source.paraphrase: Before collecting personal data in signup, the product must have a reviewed audience and jurisdiction assessment and enforce any applicable child-access restrictions or parental-consent requirements at the server boundary; an age gate alone must not be treated as COPPA compliance.

invariants.why: Before collecting personal data in signup, the product must have a reviewed audience and jurisdiction assessment and enforce any applicable child-access restrictions or parental-consent requirements at the server boundary; an age gate alone must not be treated as COPPA compliance.
invariants.fixHint: Bind PRACTICE-001 to a human-reviewed product assertion with scope, applicability, owner, evidence source and freshness controls in its rationale. Include a failing control. Run pregate fitness run PRACTICE-001; repair failed assertions. Review conditional applicability instead of returning an unexplained pass.
invariants.avoid: This is a project evidence gate, not a syntax detector or readiness certification. A receipt proves only the reviewed assertion ran on the current inputs. External legal, certification, deployment and performance evidence needs its own authenticity, scope and freshness checks inside that assertion. Missing evidence remains unverified. Pack fixtures test receipt admission, not the product requirement. Packs never supply executable commands.
